verdict.rationale: Neon supports bulk work indirectly. Agents can run multi-statement SQL through the MCP server's "Run SQL Transaction" tool, which covers set-based operations over many rows. Platforms can automate creating, configuring and cleaning up tens of thousands of projects through the Management API. neon.ts declares branch policy (TTLs, sizing) that the CLI applies through inspect/plan/apply. None of the evidence shows a dedicated batch endpoint or command for acting on many projects or branches in one call, so bulk platform operations must be scripted from per-resource API calls. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints or CLI commands for many projects or branches at once, documented bulk-operation examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
